- Sensor fusion across all modalities with low latency
- Application of latest GenAI technology for perception enrichment

## Why Customers Choose SiMa.ai for Automotive

Purpose-built silicon and software for next-generation vehicle architectures — from ADAS to in-cabin intelligence.

![Partnership](https://sima.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/synopsys.svg?w=300)

### Partnership

Joint solution with proven, industry leader to accelerate architecture and software development for AI-ready, next-generation automotive SoCs for ADAS and IVI applications.

### On-Edge Conversational AI

Low-latency LLM, VLM, and VLA inference on-device — consistent performance without cloud dependency, with better security and reduced costs.

### Best-in-Class Performance per Watt

Significant cost savings at the ECU level. Ultra-low power enables fanless designs and easy integration into existing vehicle architectures.

### Privacy and Security by Design

Local inferencing keeps sensitive data on-device. Consistent performance independent of connectivity — even in tunnels and remote areas.

### Push-Button Deployment

Palette software suite dramatically reduces development time and cost. Fast introduction into existing E/E architectures with cross-platform compatibility.

## Automotive Product Portfolio

One Physical AI platform, three deployment form factors — from stand-alone AI-Boxes and companion SOCs to future ML chiplets.
